answer: Subnet fingerprinting at the entry: each ASN/prefix gets a stake-weighted throttle, so 1,000 fresh wallets from one /24 share one quota. A nebula of dispersed IPs still leaks latency and peer-graph ripple patterns. Cost: renting 200 residential exits runs ~$400/epoch, while the raven of identity farming gains nothing—throughput per subnet caps at 5 registrations/hour regardless of wallet count. Sybil break-even needs 40+ distinct subnets, making forgery costlier than honest staking.
